The Growth team signs off on it. Since 2026-09-01 they've owned the notifier. Template and wording changes are approved in **#growth-eng**, and any Growth engineer can give the approval.

You might see an older team note saying Dana Okafor has to approve notifier changes. That's out of date: she moved to Platform. The note is already marked as replaced by the Growth team rule. The repo has no CODEOWNERS file or similar that says otherwise.

When you edit the receipt email, change both versions of the template in `services/notifier/templates/`: the `.mjml` file and the plain-text `.txt` file next to it. They must use the same variables, because some corporate mail servers strip the HTML version.
